purpose: Implement the corrected project question: do not overlay a terrestrial melt-site directly onto ICRS RA/Dec. Instead, translate the hypothetical Giza/pyramid observer frame to a real melt-site and solve what local pyramid pointing would be required for the frozen LOVE and EDEM directions, then run the result in reverse.

intent_correction.wrong_question: At what longitude does a fixed LOVE/EDEM RA/Dec ray hit Earth?
intent_correction.correct_question: If the pyramid/Giza local frame were physically translated to the melt-site, what azimuth/elevation would its pointing element need in order to intersect LOVE or EDEM at a chosen sidereal phase?
intent_correction.fifth_element_analogy: Treat PYRAMID as a project directional body/emitter-receiver analogy only. No ancient transmitter claim is admitted.
intent_correction.route_semantics: For a two-hop project route EARTH -> LOVE -> EDEM, the Earth-local ray is only the EARTH -> LOVE leg. LOVE and EDEM are separated on the terrestrial sky by about 90.59 degrees, so a single straight Earth-fixed ray cannot intersect both endpoints simultaneously.

great_pyramid_southern_kings_chamber_sha.historical_interpretation: A proposed stellar interpretation associates the southern King's Chamber shaft with Orion/Alnilam in the Old Kingdom epoch. The project uses 44.5 deg only as a reference pointing slope, not as proof of design intent.
great_pyramid_southern_kings_chamber_sha.important_distinction: The pyramid base cardinal orientation is a separate architectural fact; the star-shaft interpretation remains a hypothesis with scholarly debate.

LOVE_upper_culmination.consequence: A fixed 44.5 deg elevation shaft at Kamil can never point to LOVE at any sidereal time because LOVE never rises above about 31.20 deg.

LOVE.reason: Required altitude 44.5 deg exceeds LOVE maximum altitude at Kamil by about 13.3007 deg.

EDEM.interpretation: After translating the reference shaft slope to Kamil, EDEM is geometrically reachable only if the pointing azimuth is rotated away from the original due-south shaft direction. This is an engineered hypothetical reorientation, not a historical alignment claim.

january_2026_transfer_of_existing_projec.january_context_rule: January is retained as an observational/project timing context inherited from the executed receipts, not as an activation date.

edem_exact_44_5deg_january_crossing_near.interpretation: At Kamil, the EDEM candidate crosses the 44.5 deg reference shaft elevation about 11 minutes before the old Giza best-geometry timestamp. Orion is below the local horizon at that moment, so this is not a direct Orion/EDEM same-sky-position confusion. It is an operator-substitution geometry: a translated and horizontally reoriented reference shaft can intersect EDEM.

LOVE_upper_culmination_route_snapshot.interpretation: If a Fifth-Element-style single beam is defined as the terrestrial LOVE leg, its clean Kamil upper-culmination pointing is due south at only 31.20 deg elevation. EDEM remains a separate second-hop direction roughly one quarter-circle away.

near_orthogonal_two_channel_mapping.project_use: A two-channel or adjacent-face visualization may map LOVE and EDEM as nearly orthogonal celestial directions.
near_orthogonal_two_channel_mapping.firewall: Near-orthogonality is deterministic coordinate geometry already present in Janus-Cosmos. It is not evidence that an ancient pyramid implemented two such channels.

comparison.prior_declination_gate: Kamil independently reconstructed trajectory fails both frozen LOVE and EDEM endpoint declinations before RA is considered.

reverse_pass.result: Reduce the problem to one Earth site, two fixed celestial vectors, one optional reference shaft slope and observer-time transforms.
Solve local Kamil alt/az for LOVE, EDEM and Orion at inherited January timestamps and at time-independent culmination/reference-slope conditions.
The 44.5 deg shaft reference cannot point to LOVE from Kamil at any time, but can intersect EDEM on ENE/WNW branches if horizontally reoriented.
The hypothetical EDEM shaft direction does not match Kamil's independently reconstructed NW impact corridor, preserving the physical negative control.
The clean project geometry is KAMIL/PYRAMID -> LOVE as the terrestrial pointing leg, followed by LOVE -> EDEM as a separate celestial hop. A single Earth ray is not the LOVE-EDEM route itself.
Preserve deterministic pointing geometry, separate it from archaeological design intent, and separate both from any causal explanation of Kamil melting.

conceptual_result_ru: Теперь постановка действительно та, которую требовал пользователь: мы не переносим RA/Dec на карту Земли, а переносим саму условную Гизу в Kamil. При этом возникает полезное разделение. Если сохранять известный проектный Orion-like shaft slope около 44.5°, он физически не может смотреть на LOVE из Kamil: LOVE там поднимается максимум до ~31.20°. Зато тот же наклон может пересечь EDEM при азимуте около 291.24° на западной ветви. В январском окне 2026-01-10 точное пересечение 44.5° происходит примерно за 11 минут до старого Giza best-geometry timestamp. Но это требует большой горизонтальной переориентации и не совпадает с реконструированным направлением Kamil impactor. Поэтому новая связь — не 'Orion был рядом с EDEM', а 'после переноса локальной пирамидальной геометрии старый Orion-like оператор способен геометрически попасть в EDEM, тогда как LOVE требует отдельного более низкого луча'.

next_gate.name: KAMIL_VIRTUAL_PYRAMID_MULTI_OPERATOR_PREREG_V2
tasks: Freeze three structural operators before scoring: 44.5 deg King's Chamber south-shaft reference, ~51.84 deg pyramid-face slope reference, and free apex/beam axis.
For each operator, solve LOVE, EDEM, Orion and matched random-sky controls with identical time freedom and identical azimuth freedom.
Run both outbound KAMIL -> LOVE -> EDEM and reverse EDEM -> LOVE -> KAMIL route bookkeeping without changing celestial coordinates between faces.
Keep Kamil's real reconstructed impact corridor as an independent physical control rather than tuning the virtual pyramid to it.
Quantify whether the ~11 minute proximity to the inherited Giza January timestamp survives a frozen control set or is expected under daily crossing freedom.
